C1485.title: Qingdao Bitcoin Theft Case
C1485.summary: In July 2023, Zhang memorized a wallet seed phrase while helping Feng operate a digital wallet, recovered the missing word, took control of the wallet, and transferred 107 Bitcoin before converting them through a platform for more than RMB 660,000. After the Qingdao Licang District procuratorate prosecuted the case, the court convicted Zhang of theft, sentenced him to ten years and nine months in prison, and fined him RMB 100,000.
